jobs.occupation: Senior Service Technician Wind Turbines - Nijmegen region (233805)
jobs.description:
🌬️ Do you want to work on technology that truly makes a difference? As a Senior Service Technician, you keep wind turbines operating safely and efficiently in your region. Earn a gross salary up to € 4,500 per month, receive travel expense reimbursement and secure a direct contract with the employer. Ready for impact-driven technical work? Apply now!

Manpower is looking for a Senior Service Technician for a company in Nijmegen.

As Senior Service Technician, you will be responsible for:

    - Carrying out preventive and corrective maintenance on wind turbines
    
- Diagnosing and resolving electrical and mechanical faults
    
- Replacing large components such as generators and gearboxes
    
- Working strictly according to safety standards and NEN guidelines
    
- Documenting completed activities and incidents
    
- Assisting with inspections, retrofit projects and root cause analyses
    
- Taking part in scheduled weekend and emergency services

What’s in it for you

    - Gross monthly salary between € 3,500 and € 4,500, depending on experience
    
- Direct contract with the employer, with prospect of permanent employment
    
- Full-time position of 40 hours per week
    
- Travel expense reimbursement according to company policy
    
- 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days
    
- Company van for commuting from home to sites
    
- Extensive training and recertification opportunities
    
- Career progression towards specialist or managerial roles
    
- Regional assignments with limited travel time

    - Minimum mbo level 3 or mbo level 4 diploma in Electrical Engineering or similar field, or relevant experience
    
- At least three years of electrical engineering experience
    
- Knowledge of hydraulics and or mechanics is an advantage
    
- NEN 3140 and NEN 3840 certification, or willingness to obtain
    
- Strong English communication skills due to reporting and safety documentation
    
- Valid driving license B
    
- Ability to work at heights and good physical condition
    
- Independent and solution
